title: Interview Prep
description: AI-powered interview preparation platform for realistic, role-specific interview practice based on a candidate's CV and target job specification.

screens.title: CV interview setup
screens.description: Configure an interview by providing the candidate's CV, which provides the foundation for role-specific interview preparation.

screens.title: Job specification setup
screens.description: Provide the target job specification so the interview can focus on the requirements, responsibilities, and skills relevant to the role.

screens.title: Interactive interview session
screens.description: Practise realistic interview questions through a turn-by-turn interview experience with spoken questions, candidate responses, and interactive interview controls.

screens.title: AI interview reflection
screens.description: Review structured post-interview feedback covering observations, strengths, communication, growth opportunities, overall impression, and the next area to focus on.

screens.title: InterviewPrep ASP.NET Core Web API
screens.description: Explore the backend API used to manage interview sessions, questions, answers, and session completion through documented REST endpoints.

screens.title: Supplier management

screens.title: API documentation
screens.description: Swagger documentation exposes the backend API for items, stock, value, and low-stock endpoints.
